newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends marginally up on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends marginally up on foreign demand.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia ended four cents higher at 14.11 ringgit ($5.62) a kg on demand from foreigners, despite lower prices in London overnight.
Traders said there were some buying interest from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.

Prices are likely to move at around current levels, they said, expecting the near-term trend to depend on the London market. Turnover was unchanged at Monday's 88 tonnes. The local price premium rose to $70 a tonne against yesterday's $20. --Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911) ($1=2.5090 ringgit)
